title: Onine Video Now Available
description: Archived closing announcement for the Hong Kong 2013 OpenStack Summit, thanking participants and introducing recordings of keynotes, talks and panels.
body: The OpenStack 2013 Summit in Hong Kong has concluded. We'd like to thank our sponsors, attendees, and community for an amazing event. Video from the event is being uploaded to our growing collection of keynotes, talks and panels available for viewing online.
seoTitle: OpenStack Summit Hong Kong 2013 — Onine Video Now Available
archiveNotice: Archived event content. Dates, registration information and policies below apply to this historical Summit.
